title: Rights Clarity Breadcrumbs and Incident Playback Prototype
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Admins and auditors struggle to quickly understand why a user has access to a resource across workspaces and what change led to that access. Existing audit timelines are dense; product owners want a compact inspector that surfaces the minimal set of grants and policy decisions that create access, plus the cost and rollout context for the model routes involved.

Goal: Create a compact, scan-first UI pattern that combines: 1) an access "breadcrumbs" strip (human readable causal chain of grants and role inheritance), 2) a lightweight incident-playback timeline (what changed and when), and 3) inline cost-attribution tags for model routes involved in the access path. The prototype should make it easy to escalate, simulate revocation (what-if), and link to rollout/handoff actions in the Console.
high_level_solution: Design a compact inspector panel that opens from audit rows and workspace user pages. The top row shows a visual breadcrumbs chain (Org -> Workspace -> Role -> Grant -> Model Route) with tappable nodes. Beneath, a horizontal micro-timeline shows the last six changes affecting the chain with a fast-forward playback control. Right column surfaces cost context for each model route (monthly estimate, SLO tier) and provides quick actions: simulate revoke, open rollout, create ticket. Prototype includes mobile-responsive variants and keyboard-first interactions for power users.
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumbs visual displays full causal chain and highlights the minimal grants responsible for access
Timeline can step between historical changes (day/week/month granularity) and shows actor + commit message or PR link
Cost tags for model routes show 30-day estimated spend and SLO tier, and link to per-route console view
Simulation action opens a sandbox preview that marks downstream dependents and suggested mitigations
Prototype shipped to design review with Figma frames, annotated flows, and copy for microcopy and error states
Design handoff includes accessibility notes (keyboard navigation, screen reader labels) and interaction spec

decisions: Keep breadcrumbs read-only by default; expose edit/simulate actions in a compact action menu to reduce accidental changes
Limit timeline playback to 50 events by default with 'Load more' to preserve performance
Obfuscate any principal identifiers until the user confirms elevated audit scope to meet privacy guidelines
Surface cost tags inline but link to the canonical per-route cost dashboard rather than duplicating metrics
